description: Screenshots a URL on simulated devices without any browser window or the extension, using Playwright with real device emulation (viewport, pixel ratio, touch, mobile mode, user agent). Safari devices render in WebKit, the others in Chromium. 'device' and 'screen' images have a transparent background. Pages behind a login need storage_state.

browser.description: Browser UI and user agent to emulate. Defaults to Safari on Apple devices, Chrome on Android.

frame.description: viewport mode only: false uses the whole screen as the page instead of leaving room for status and browser bars

full_page.description: viewport mode only: capture the full scrollable page

max_width.description: Images are rendered at most this wide (and at most at the device's pixel ratio)

mode.description: device: with bezel and stand; screen: display with status and browser bars; viewport: the web page only

save_dir.description: Also write the PNGs to this directory and return their paths

storage_state.description: Path to a Playwright storage-state JSON (cookies and localStorage) for signed-in pages

wait_ms.description: Extra time after load, for animations and late content

name: view_sim_headless_screenshot
title: Headless screenshot
